ATIONS DEMANDÉES 3.1 PRESTATIONS FERMES : Les prestations fermes portent sur la refonte graphique du magazine de la collectivité, puis sur l’exécution graphique et la mise en page de deux numéros par an pendant la durée du marché. Mais il relève aussi du dilemme quand vient l’instant de désigner les vainqueurs. Entrent en balance des critères prédéfinis autour de la viabilité économique ou encore du caractère innovant du projet mais aussi une part d’affect, naturellement. Les résultats, passés à la moulinette, donnent une moyenne et un classement. « Ces notes sont une orientation, pas un avis définitif », prévient l’un des participants. Les débats s’engagent alors. Et si le choix pour l’un des prix ne créé pas dissension, pour l’autre, ça bataille. « Doit-on favoriser le projet qui a le plus fort potentiel pour le territoire ou l’entrepreneur qui est le plus dans le besoin ? » s’interrogent plusieurs jurés. « Il me paraît difficile de récompenser celui ou celle qui a terminé en 5 e ou 6 e position », tempère l’un d’entre eux. « Attention à ne pas élire un projet trop fragile », embraye un autre. Falls ja, welche Nachweise sind hierfür im Rahmen des Teilnahmeantrags bzw. Angebots erforderlich? Nein, neben festangestellten Mitarbeitenden können keine freien Mitarbeitende berücksichtigt werden (Dokument Erklärung zur Eignung, Punkt 2.2.1 Mitarbeiter) Sollten die geforderten personellen Eignungen mit den eigenen festangestellten Mitarbeitenden nicht vollständig erfüllt werden können, besteht die Möglichkeit, • eine Bietergemeinschaft zu bilden oder • eine Eignungsleihe in Anspruch zu nehmen. Die jeweils erforderlichen Nachweise sind dann gemäß den Vorgaben der Vergabeunterlagen im Angebot beizubringen. Anhaenge, Seite: 2 lfd. Eine darüberhinausgehende ausführliche Ausarbeitung ist nicht erforderlich. Die Bieter sollen jedoch erkennen lassen, welche übergeordnete kommunikative Idee den drei Assets zugrunde liegt und wie diese miteinander zusammenhängen. Eine gesonderte Präsentation oder ein zusätzliches Konzeptdokument wird hierfür nicht erwartet; die konzeptionelle Herleitung soll im Rahmen der geforderten 500-Zeichen-Erläuterung erfolgen. 7 Teil der Unterlagen sind die "Erklärung zum Nachunternehmereinsatz" sowie die "Verpflichtungs- und Eigenerklärung zur Eignungsleihe". V primeru skupne ponudbe lahko pogoj partnerji izpolnijo skupaj. V primeru, da ponudnik nastopa s podizvajalci, lahko pogoj ponudnik in podizvajalci dokazujejo skupno. DOKAZILO: - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz prve alineje prvega odstavka te točke: Izpolnjen obrazec P- 10 Referenca ponudnika. Referenca mora biti potrjena s strani naročnika referenčnega posla s podpisom. V kolikor se referenca nanaša na naročnika (Ministrstvo za zunanje in evropske zadeve), ponudnik izpolni vse podatke, vendar podpis reference s strani naročnika ni potreben. - V primeru izpolnjevanja pogoja iz druge alineje prvega odstavka te točke: ustrezna navedba v točki 3 obrazca P-2 Prijava in dokazila o izkušnjah ter sodelovanju strokovnjaka (npr. pogodba o zaposlitvi). 9.4.2 Vsi kadri ponudnika, ki bodo opravljali dela predmetnega javnega naročila, bodo varnostno preverjeni s strani naročnika v skladu z 16a. členom Zakona o zunanjih zadevah (Uradni list RS št. 113/03– uradno prečiščeno besedilo, s spremembami in dopo

zvesti javno naročilo s podizvajalcem, ki zahteva neposredno plačilo, mora: - glavni izvajalec v pogodbi pooblastiti naročnika, da na podlagi potrjenega računa oziroma situacije s strani glavnega izvajalca neposredno plačuje podizvajalcu, - podizvajalec predložiti soglasje, na podlagi katerega naročnik namesto ponudnika poravna podizvajalčevo terjatev do ponudnika, - glavni i zvajalec svojemu računu ali situaciji priložiti račun ali situacijo podizvajalca, ki ga je predhodno potrdil. V primeru nastopanja s podizvajalci, kjer ni neposrednega plačila, mora glavni izvajalec najpozneje v 60 dneh od plačila končnega računa oziroma situacije poslati naročniku svojo pisno izjavo in pisno izjavo podizvajalca, da je podizvajalec prejel plačilo za izvedene gradnje ali storitve oziroma dobavljeno blago, neposredno povezano s predmetom javnega naročila. V nasprotnem primeru naročnik Državni revizijski komisiji poda predlog za uvedbo postopka o prekršku iz 2. točke prvega odstavka 112. člena ZJN-3. Ponudnik v razmerju do naročnika v celoti odgovarja za izvedbo prejetega naročila, ne glede na število podizvajalcev, ki jih navede v svoji ponudbi. Izbrani izvajalec bo moral med izvajanjem javnega naročila naročnika obvestiti o morebitnih spremembah glede podizvajalcev, ki jih namerava nakn

avnem varstvu v postopkih javnega naročanja (Uradni list RS, št. 43/11 s spremembami in dopolnitvami, v nadaljnjem besedilu ZPVPJN). Navodila ponudnikom Stran 18/18 Zahtevek za revizijo se vloži preko portala e-Revizija. Vlagatelj mora skladno z 71. členom ZPVPJN plačati takso v višini 4.000,00 EUR na transakcijski račun Ministrstva za finance, št. 01100-1000358802, odprt pri Banki Slovenije, Slovenska 35, 1505 Ljubljana, sklic 11 16110-7111290-00010326, namen nakazila: taksa za postopek revizije javnega naročanja. To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. This toolset is essential for the iSMART (interoperable Systems Management and Requirements Transformation) process and is used to populate, edit, analyze, and manage TDL message data, platform implementations, and interoperability evaluations. 2.0 SCOPE The Contractor shall provide a commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software solution, including all necessary licenses, updates, training, and technical support. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations. When preparing a competitive quotation, vendors should take into consideration benefits provided through the national healthcare system. Quotations should refrain from over customization, and should be “off the shelf”, “commercially available”, or “market ready” products which are designed to be complementary and supplement to the national system in Portugal. The benefit levels listed from section C.1.1 through C.1.24 are a standard package that must be provided. C.1.1 Eligibility: To be eligible to participate in the medical plan, LE Staff (both full time and part time) must be: -- Paid under the terms of the Local Compensation Plan (LCP); and – -- Under a non-temporary direct hire appointment, personal services agreement (PSA), or personal services contract (PSC); or -- Under a temporary direct hire appointment or PSA Fixed Term of one year or more. Not eligible are those working under temporary appointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor l

ointments; those working under a PSC or PSA that is time limited to less than one year; non-personal services contract personnel and their employees, supplied by an independent contractor licensed to do business in Portugal who provides services to other local RFP 19GE5026Q0035 – LES Health Insurance Services for U.S. Embassy Lisbon Page 6 of 21 organizations as well as to the U.S. Mission; employees working on an intermittent or When Actually Employed (WAE) schedule; Peace Corps personal services contractors and Recreation Association employees. C.1.2 Riders: There are no riders under this contract. C.1.3 Periods of Ineligibility: Employees and their dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment for which premiums are not paid. Additionally, employee's dependents are not entitled to health benefits during any period of employment during which the employee was not eligible to participate. During a period of extended Leave Without Pay (LWOP) or other unpaid leave beyond one pay period, the employee is responsible for the full cost of the insurance premiums for self and dependents. The Mission will pay the premiums directly to the Contractor and will collect the full cost from the employee on a quarterly basis. Alternatively

STATEMENT OF WORK C. 1. OVERVIEW/BACKGROUND. The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory

The Library of Congress (Library) requires a contractor to produce, maintain, and support the latest generation of Digital Talking Book Machine (DTBM) devices, known as the DA2 (DTBM model Digital Advanced version 2), which were originally launched June 18, 2025. The National Library Service for the Blind and Print Disabled (NLS) provides free books and magazines in audio and braille format to eligible U.S. residents and citizens living abroad. NLS’ enabling legislation was changed in 2016 (Public Law 114-219) to permit NLS to develop and distribute devices to be used for reading any format, including DAISY (Digital Accessible Information System). As part of these services and products offered, NLS loans free DTBMs for use in consuming NLS-produced audio materials. NLS-produced audio materials are distributed via NLS DTBM cartridges and data files online via Braille and Audio Reading Download (BARD) website in AMR-WB+, MPEG I/Layer 3 (MP3), RIFF WAV, and other audio formats. NLS requires additional DA2 units, consistent with the existing inventory of NLS DA2 devices. NLS requires quantities suffi
